images.name: 260329 Hidalgo [1296x729]

articles.headline: Friday Night Lights,' 'Ted Lasso' top poll ranking 21st-century sports shows

images.name: TV Show Rankings [1296x518]

images.name: Cobra Kai [2100x1676]

article.story: STILLWATER, Okla. -- — Liv McGill scored 30 points for her second straight 30-plus effort and No. 25 Oklahoma State defeated St. John's 77-63 on Wednesday night. McGill scored 34 points on Sunday in a 90-80 win over South Dakota State. McGill had seven rebounds, six assists and three steals on Wednesday. Stailee Heard scored 14 points and Audi Crooks, whose playing time was limited by foul trouble, scored 11 points before fouling out late in the fourth quarter. Brooke Moore scored 19, Ny’Ceara Pryor 15 and Sa’Mya Wyatt 14 for St. John's (4-1). St. John's led 15-13 after one quarter, then Oklahoma State (5-1) went on a 13-2 run through the first 5 1/2 minutes of the second quarter. Oklahoma State led 37-26 at halftime after holding the Red Storm to 35% shooting from the field that included 1 of 12 3-pointers. The Cowgirls maintained a double-digit lead throughout the second half. St. John's got within 10 points once in the third quarter. McGill and Crooks each scored nine points for all 18 of the Cowgirls' points in the fourth quarter. The game was a rematch of last season’s meeting in New York, where St. John’s beat OSU 74-67. They are the only two matchups between the two programs. The game was the Cowgirls’ annual Remember The 4 game, honoring former head coach Kurt Budke, assistant coach Miranda Serna and supporters Olin and Paula Branstetter, who lost their lives in a plane crash in Arkansas on Nov. 17, 2011. Up next Oklahoma State: The Cowgirls host Little Rock on Friday. St. John's: The Red Storm play UCLA at the Basketball Hall of Fame Women’s Showcase on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
